# Stornio

> Stornio is a subscription tracker and cancellation-letter app for iOS and Android (first market: Hungary, then Germany and the EU). No account, no bank connection, no server storing user data: everything stays on the device. It prepares withdrawal, cancellation and complaint letters from templates; the user sends them. It is not a legal service and does not give legal advice.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6828555991
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=hu.iade.iade
- Support: https://yukokunoshi.github.io/stornio/index-en.html
- Privacy: https://yukokunoshi.github.io/stornio/privacy-en.html

## Guides (English)

General information about EU consumer rules (Directive 2011/83/EU, Directive (EU) 2019/771, Directive (EU) 2015/2366), not legal advice.

- [How to return an online purchase in the EU (14-day right of withdrawal)](https://yukokunoshi.github.io/stornio/guides/en/return-online-purchase-eu-14-day-withdrawal/): The EU 14-day right of withdrawal for online, phone and doorstep purchases: when the 14 days start, how to withdraw, who pays for the return and when you get your money back.
- [How long do I have to return something I bought in a shop?](https://yukokunoshi.github.io/stornio/guides/en/return-item-bought-in-shop/): There is no general EU right to return a non-faulty item bought in a physical shop. What the shop's return policy means, and what you can do if the item is faulty.
- [How to cancel a subscription and get a refund, step by step](https://yukokunoshi.github.io/stornio/guides/en/cancel-subscription-get-refund/): A practical order of steps for cancelling a subscription: find where you signed up, check the terms, cancel in writing, keep proof, and when you can ask for money back.
- [Statutory warranty (legal guarantee) vs. commercial warranty in the EU](https://yukokunoshi.github.io/stornio/guides/en/legal-guarantee-vs-commercial-warranty-eu/): The EU legal guarantee lasts at least two years and is free; a commercial warranty is an extra, voluntary promise. What each covers and whom to contact.
- [How to keep receipts and warranty documents in one place](https://yukokunoshi.github.io/stornio/guides/en/keep-receipts-warranty-documents-one-place/): A simple system for receipts, invoices, contracts and warranty documents, so you can prove a purchase or a cancellation when you need to.
- [Free-trial traps: how to not get charged](https://yukokunoshi.github.io/stornio/guides/en/free-trial-avoid-being-charged/): How free trials turn into paid subscriptions, and a short checklist to cancel in time: note the end date, set a reminder, cancel in the right place, keep proof.
- [Template: letter to cancel a subscription](https://yukokunoshi.github.io/stornio/guides/en/subscription-cancellation-letter-template/): A free, short template for cancelling a subscription in writing, plus the EU model wording for withdrawing within 14 days. Copy it and fill in your details.
- [Charged after cancelling a subscription? How to get the money back](https://yukokunoshi.github.io/stornio/guides/en/charged-after-cancelling-get-money-back/): What to do if a company keeps charging you after you cancelled: write to them with proof, and what your bank can do for direct debits and unauthorised payments.
